title: Your first minute in XRP Mobile
description: Just installed XRP Mobile? This short tour walks through every tab: the Wallet home with buy, send, receive and swap, the Earn roadmap, the Explore market, the Share referral campaign, and the settings behind the gear. A good first watch before any other tutorial.
lede: You've just made a wallet and the app is staring back at you. Here is what every tab does, in under a minute.

steps.caption: Wallet is home
steps.body: Wallet is where you land: your balance, the four things you can do with it, and your tokens and activity underneath.

steps.caption: Earn, still on the way
steps.body: Earn is honest about itself. There is no yield product yet, just what we are building and a way to be told when it lands.

steps.caption: Explore is the market
steps.body: Explore is the market: what is moving today, every token we list, and a page per token with its chart.

steps.caption: Share is the campaign
steps.body: Share is the referral campaign. Your points, the leaderboard, and the tasks that earn you a slice of the pot.

steps.caption: Settings behind the gear
steps.body: The gear holds the rest: your currency, your language, your PIN, your backup, and support.

steps.caption: Back to your wallet
steps.body: And you are never more than one tap from your wallet.
